why: I checked both must_not items against all 8 expect lines and their proofs. Item 1: every line can be checked at the PR head. The CI line says "passes on the pull request", which is a check on the PR, not something that only exists after merge. Publishing to npm is listed as a non-goal. No line depends on a release or a published package. Item 2: one expect line requires "`node:test` tests covering an invalid-row file, a valid file and a missing file, and `npm ci && npm test` at the repo root runs them". Its proof checks that the tests are listed in the npm test output and that the test files import node:test and cover the three cases. A tool without tests run by npm test would fail that line, so it can't meet the issue's lines. The output breaks neither item.
